'''Polow''' was a graduate of the [[Galactic Alliance Space Academy]] and served as an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] sometime in [[44 ABY]]. Polow commanded the task force guarding the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] aboard the [[Light cruiser/Legends|Light Cruiser]] ''[[Regalle]]'' and gave the order to give chase to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] when it tried to land on the planet. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], who was aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'', deduced that Polow might be a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] working undercover since an officer who graduated from the Galactic Alliance Space Academy would be no higher than a [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]].<ref name="apocalypse" />
